result.final: Lowest price for the Wexcombe t-shirt in size M (where M is not sold out) is $11.92 at Haldane Apparel (Wexcombe Midweight Jersey Tee, Short Sleeve, http://localhost:7770/igr-tcl-40.html). Price was read from the product page after selecting size M. I opened 5 listings in ascending advertised-price order: Dovercourt Apparel ($10.13, no M option offered), Whitlock Outfitters ($11.09, M sold out), Carnforth Textile Company ($11.38, M = $13.02), Oakfield Textile Company ($11.69, M sold out), and Haldane Apparel ($11.92, M = $11.92, the winner). I skipped the other 40 listings: each has an advertised price of at least $12.85 (the next-cheapest unopened listing, Dalston Textiles), which is already at or above my best found total of $11.92. Because the advertised price is the cheapest buyable option in each listing, any size M in those listings would cost at least its advertised price — so none could beat $11.92. Skipping them was therefore safe, and I stopped once no unopened listing had an advertised price below the best total.
